whyMatters.en: Mark II lineup (Blackmore / Gillan / Glover / Lord / Paice) set hard rock’s organ-plus-riff classroom: Machine Head (1972) and the Made in Japan live document.
whyMatters.zh: Mark II 阵容（Blackmore / Gillan / Glover / Lord / Paice）定下 hard rock「管风琴 + riff」课堂：Machine Head（1972）与现场专辑 Made in Japan。

shortBio.en: British hard-rock band; Smoke on the Water made the open-fifth riff a global teaching tool.
shortBio.zh: 英国 hard-rock 乐队；Smoke on the Water 把开放五度 riff 做成全球教学工具。

body.en:
Formed 1968; the commercially decisive era is 1970–73 Mark II. In Rock We Trust and Machine Head fused Jon Lord’s Hammond with Blackmore’s blues-classical guitar figures.

Smoke on the Water (1972) is the riff everyone learns; Highway Star and Lazy show the speed and jazz-blues stretch. They sit with Sabbath and Zeppelin as early-70s hard-rock pillars, more organ-forward than either.
body.zh:
1968 年组建；商业与风格决定期是 1970–73 的 Mark II。In Rock 与 Machine Head 把 Jon Lord 的 Hammond 与 Blackmore 的蓝调—古典吉他音型焊在一起。

Smoke on the Water（1972）是人人会弹的 riff；Highway Star、Lazy 展示速度与爵士蓝调延伸。与 Sabbath、Zeppelin 同属 70 年代初 hard-rock 支柱，管风琴比重更高。
